P1.1.text: HireQuest Inc. | Staffing & Recruiting Services Franchise

P1.2.text: HireQuest connects businesses with reliable staffing and recruiting solutions nationwide—temporary, direct hire, and workforce solutions across industries.

P1.3.text: A leader across staffing/recruiting industry with multiple offices around the globe.

P1.4.text: Hire Smarter, Work Stronger: Tailored Talent Solutions for Your Business Success

P1.5.text: At HireQuest, we understand that every business is unique, and so are its workforce needs. That’s why our family of brands is dedicated to providing tailored staffing solutions that help companies thrive. Whether you’re looking for temporary staffing to meet seasonal demands, skilled professionals to fill critical roles, or strategic recruitment support to build a winning team, HireQuest delivers with expertise, efficiency, and unmatched service. Partnering with us and our divisions means gaining access to a global network of recruiting and staffing professionals who are committed to driving your business forward, one impactful hire at a time.

P1.6.text: Our growth is strategically informed by more than 200 years of experience both in the staffing industry and in those industries we serve every day.

P1.7.text: A commitment to our franchisees, our customers, and our communities inspires the work we do every day. We are proud to offer peerless customer service at every level of our business.

P1.8.text: HireQuest franchisees operate coast to coast—in 47 states and Washington, D.C., and in multiple countries worldwide. Across our four proven franchise models—HireQuest Direct, Snelling, TradeCorp, and MRINetwork—we’re actively seeking driven partners ready to grow with us. Strategic expansion starts with the right people. Let’s build something together.

P1.9.text: → Snelling – Philadelphia, PA → Snelling – Kansas City, MO

P1.10.text: For more information on these – contact Dave Gerstner directly

P1.11.text: Due to recent changes in federal law, we are now only required to furnish Form 1095-C upon request.

P2.1.text: Who We Are - HireQuest Inc. | Staffing & Recruiting Services Franchise

P2.2.text: Learn who we are at HireQuest—our mission, values, and leadership behind our nationwide staffing and workforce solutions.

P2.3.text: HireQuest is a franchisor of staffing solutions with a presence across the U.S. and international markets. Through its primary divisions – HireQuest Direct, HireQuest Health, MRINetwork, Snelling, and TradeCorp – the company provides temporary, direct-hire, and contract staffing solutions across industries, including construction, light industrial, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, cybersecurity, and engineering. From on-demand staffing to executive search, HireQuest’s divisions operate as one team for our customers -delivering workforce solutions that drive growth and change lives. Our flourishing franchise owners are as diverse as the communities they serve, and include veterans, women, minorities, first-time business owners, and families. They are all just as dedicated as we are to helping individuals rejoin the workforce and supporting businesses as they scale.

P2.4.text: At HireQuest, our mission is to strengthen local communities by transforming how people find work and how work gets done

P2.5.text: HireQuest and its divisions of brands are transforming how the world works. From major global cities to local hubs of industry, we’re helping businesses build stronger workforces and people find purpose through employment.

P2.6.text: We envision a future where every person, in every community, can find empowerment through work.

P2.7.text: A future where entrepreneurship is within reach for anyone willing to build it.

P2.8.text: A future where companies can scale with confidence—anytime, anywhere.

P2.9.text: We’re building a world where work works—for everyone. Every day of the year, around the globe.

P2.10.text: Meet the Visionaries Leading Us into the Future

P2.11.text: We know there’s a solution to every problem the American working world faces.

P2.12.text: These are the values we hold close as we commit to our mission and our vision of the future:
